correctness.rationale: A standalone exhaustive C++ proof-by-enumeration regenerates all 1,910,200 nonempty faces from thirty-two 16-vertex balls, verifies every matching pair, enumerates all 15,768,064 codimension-one Hasse covers, and topologically sorts their matched-reversed directed graph with all 1,910,200 vertices visited. Exactly 955,064 matches leave critical vector (one dimension-zero, eleven dimension-four, sixty dimension-six). A separate Python enumeration corroborates the complete face vector and reduced Euler 71. Standard discrete Morse theorem yields the 72-cell CW model; published integral homology confirms minimality; Hilton–Milnor and mod-two linear algebra prove the conditional suspension-of-CP2 decomposition. No value of Sq2 rank claimed.

value.rationale: The five-cube scale-four nerve is explicitly listed in the fundamental paper as a homotopy-unknown case with two distinct known nonzero Betti degrees. The verified optimal Morse collapse simultaneously attains all degreewise CW lower bounds, replacing a 1.91-million-face complex by 72 critical cells and giving a natural complete description of the remaining potential Hopf attachments. It supplies actionable structural progress towards the cited wedge-of-spheres question rather than repeating the known Betti numbers. It does not settle the final Steenrod rank or the stronger collapsibility conjecture.
